armingSummary: first reason code plus additional count

visualChecks: All accepted images were regenerated from the exact final main and decoder hashes. Every image was visually reviewed at native 480x272.
The compass uses the full area above the attitude display. The arming shortcut is icon only in its reserved right footer target; normal status and warning text stay inside the remaining footer area.
All 12 pages retain a clear footer. The top compass button and persistent MSP text are absent. Global navigation, configuration edits/actions and other content remain clear.

Known API1.48/count30/bit18 displays the named GPS reason. Multi-reason state permits reading GPS separately; unknown API/count remains numbered, zero mask does not assert readiness, absent status displays FLAGS --, old status is explicit, and bit31 outside count30 produces STATUS ERROR.

The dynamic Setup regression focuses the alert while LQ85 is low, then restores category highlight in the same rendered state after LQ100 recovery; ENTER opens the first category. Setup PREV from first category focuses Arm, ENTER opens it and RTN restores Setup. GPS origin and an active changed battery edit are restored after Arm/RTN. Normal and warning-state arming control touch and ENTER focus/activation open Arm Info; RTN returns. Missing telemetry and valid numeric zero remain distinct.
knownHostNotices: Node ExperimentalWarning: WASI is an experimental feature
limitations: The native simulator is EdgeTX3.0.0 WASM; target radio EdgeTX2.12.4 rendering/API behavior, live telemetry, physical poses and hardware performance remain unverified.

Telemetry, switches and MSP replies are synthetic inputs in one isolated reused runtime. UI LIVE/CURRENT wording describes fixture freshness, not a real quad during this run. Production contains no fixture prefix; no radio was modified.
Desktop draw-rate diagnostics are not a radio FPS or memory benchmark. Physical readability at30-40cm has not been measured.
Unknown APIs or counts intentionally use numbered fallback; a clear disable mask never proves the aircraft armed or ready.
